title: Collection of 9/11 precognitive dreams

tellings.quote: when the 9/11 World Trade Center disaster occurred in New York it occurred to me that this would be a fantastic research opportunity so with within 3 days I had posters up in Washington Square um and I ran a series of ads in the Village Voice um asking did you dream of the World Trade Center and I have a collection of more than 75 dreams that people sent me

plain: The scientist Rupert Sheldrake says that within three days of the 9/11 attacks on the World Trade Center he put up posters in Washington Square and ran ads in the New York paper the Village Voice asking, "did you dream of the World Trade Center". He tells Michels he collected more than 75 dreams that people sent him. He saw the disaster as "a fantastic research opportunity", since dreams like these, if real, would mean people can sense events before they happen.
